outcome: Neonatal outcomes (gestational age, birth weight, congenital malformations, neonatal complications like sepsis, RSV infection)
Child health trajectories (diagnosis of CAPS in offspring, hearing loss, amyloidosis in offspring)
cohort: Consecutive adult patients with Cryopyrin-Associated Periodic Syndromes (CAPS) and their partners, screened for pregnancies and anti-IL-1 exposure.
finding: The benefit-risk ratio of maternal and paternal anti-IL-1 exposure during conception and pregnancy in CAPS patients was favourable, with good neonatal outcomes and no congenital malformations observed.
